submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L3 at a provisional 40 GeV threshold. Algorithm-L1 is rejected despite likely stronger reconstruction because its measured 5.8 us FPGA latency exceeds the 4.0 us Level-1 buffer budget. Algorithm-L2 satisfies latency but is the least sophisticated fixed-window sum. Algorithm-L3 is the best latency-compliant candidate, using sliding-window clustering with learned calibration and measured 3.1 us latency. No rate/efficiency scan or simulation output was available in the provided project documents/tools, so the exact 8 kHz operating threshold and the >=80% signal-efficiency hard requirement cannot be independently verified from the available evidence; 40 GeV is therefore the central in-range working point to be validated against the rate/efficiency simulation before freezing the trigger menu.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: The rate allocation document gives 8 kHz, and Algorithm-L3 is the most capable candidate that passes latency. However, no signal-efficiency or rate-vs-threshold scan was available in the provided documents/tools to prove it is the highest-efficiency operating point.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Algorithm-L1, Algorithm-L2, and Algorithm-L3; the recommendation is Algorithm-L3.

requirements.requirement: The signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%. This is a hard requirement.
requirements.evidence: No efficiency-at-8-kHz simulation result was available in the provided documents/tools, so the >=80% hard requirement cannot be verified.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm's latency on the Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: firmware_testbench_results.md reports Algorithm-L3 latency of 3.1 us, below the 4.0 us budget. Algorithm-L1 is excluded because it is 5.8 us.
The recommended threshold is 40 GeV, within the allowed 20-60 GeV range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
